name: Wit of the Ancient Lighthouse
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area: 20-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Every creature within the area of effect suffers 2d6 points of fire damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. For the duration of the encounter, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against creatures who failed this save.
